attempts.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member etcd 2.2.5 cluster (node1/node2/node3, Ubuntu 16.04 i386, package from apt since no pre-existing cluster was found) and wrote application keys. Simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, wiped its data directory so recovery from local data was impossible), then performed the standard etcd replacement procedure: removed the dead member (9e27ac9b72d2dc69) via `etcdctl member remove` while node1/node2 quorum stayed healthy, added a new member (a42e73c624ed3d37) via `etcdctl member add`, and started etcd on node3 with ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=existing and a fresh data dir. The new member synced and all pre-existing application keys were verified present on node3. Enabled etcd on all nodes for boot persistence. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot IDs and etcd health for all three nodes, then rebooted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time (never concurrently), confirming a changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id on each after restart, and confirming `etcdctl cluster-health`/`member list` showed 3/3 healthy members with all application keys (including a post-replacement marker key) intact after each individual restart before proceeding to the next node.
